The offer

One property.
90 days.
A decision at the end.

A contained pilot designed to establish whether hotel guests use the experience and whether the model is worth rolling out.

Days 1–14Set up

Agree the guest profile, hotel message and placements. Create a co-branded entry page, a property-specific QR code and launch materials.

Days 15–75Run live

Make the experience available at agreed guest touchpoints. Review anonymous engagement and refine the wording or placement where useful.

Days 76–90Decide

Deliver a concise readout: usage, guest and staff feedback, what changed, and a clear recommendation to stop, iterate or scale.

Included in the pilot
  • Co-branded mobile entry page
  • Property-specific QR code
  • Reception and digital launch assets
  • Short staff briefing
  • Anonymous engagement review
  • End-of-pilot recommendation

Success measures are agreed before launch—for example scans, experience starts, useful onward actions and staff feedback.
